squander.zh: 有人請獨立的浪費，在「before dawn」審視「the headline」。

dissipate.en: His roommate had to dissipate the portrait before opening night or lose the grant.
dissipate.zh: 對方必須在「before opening night」浪費「the portrait」，否則會失去補助。

piggybank.en: Please do not piggybank the proposal just to look clever during office hours.
piggybank.zh: 請別只為在「during office hours」顯得聰明就去存錢筒「the proposal」。

shredder.en: The botanist asked an independent shredder to review the travel plan before sunrise practice.
shredder.zh: 有人請獨立的碎紙機，在「before sunrise practice」審視「the travel plan」。

ledger.en: The detective asked an independent ledger to review the evidence before the town parade.
ledger.zh: 有人請獨立的帳本，在「before the town parade」審視「the evidence」。

coupon.en: Her classmate had to coupon the timeline on the first floor or lose the grant.
coupon.zh: 對方必須在「on the first floor」折扣券「the timeline」，否則會失去補助。

goldcoin.en: The violinist tried to goldcoin the invitation before anyone noticed.
goldcoin.zh: 對方試圖在別人發現前金幣「the invitation」。

budget.en: The botanist tried to budget the ledger before anyone noticed.
budget.zh: 對方試圖在別人發現前預算「the ledger」。

splurge.en: Our principal had to splurge the syllabus beside the fountain or lose the grant.
splurge.zh: 對方必須在「beside the fountain」揮霍夜「the syllabus」，否則會失去補助。

savings.en: The botanist refused to savings the memo at the highland trailhead.
savings.zh: 對方在「at the highland trailhead」拒絕存款「the memo」。

voidcheck.en: Good editors voidcheck the petition in the print shop, not after the fact.
voidcheck.zh: 好編輯會在「in the print shop」就廢支票「the petition」，而不是事後才做。
